rulings.item: option 1b: startup_instr_c 2106 vs 2105 (base and run 2's (a)): one instruction per process opens the library's own allocation fast path; zero needs a word written only at start-up to carry the open, but the routing decision (early_init) precedes init_initial; the other zero route (a routed bit in the malloc DEBUG word) sends the C malloc entries onto their general path in routed processes
rulings.recommendation: accept +1 instruction once per process for -16 per allocation and -8 per release (and -15..-28 on the other start rows vs base) and land 1b; do not land option 2
